verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a tax compliance API, so cross-border B2B VAT handling is a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence covers only US-style sales tax: nexus, product taxability, exemption records and certificates, and address validation. Nothing shows VAT or tax ID validation against official registries (such as VIES) or automatic reverse-charge application for B2B cross-border sales.
